newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Treasury to launch 18-mth T-bills April 28.
newsitem.headline: Spain Treasury to launch 18-mth T-bills April 28.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury said on Thursday it would launch 18-month Treasury bills on April 28.
"The Treasury is launching the regular issuance of 18-month bills. The first auction will take place on April 28," the Treasury said in a statement.
Earlier, Spanish Treasury General Director Jaime Caruana confirmed the operation to Reuters, adding that the new issue would be launched on April 30.
The Treasury confirmed the initial auction date would be April 28.
